title: Modified Nasal Swab For Detection of Sars-Cov2
author: Joseph Patterson
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bfavjie6

steps.title: Prepare and Transport Swabbing Kit
steps.instruction: Transport the swabbing kit to the collection site.

substeps.instruction: Ensure the kit contains a buccal swab, cooler, ice packs, spray bottle with 70% ethanol, biohazard bags, and necessary paperwork.

steps.title: Set Up Collection Area
steps.instruction: Prepare the materials for the individual self-swabbing.

substeps.instruction: Place the biohazard bag in the cooler on top of cooler packs.
Place the biohazard bag on a clean surface and back away.
Take the swab out of the kit, place it on a clean surface, and back away so the individual can pick it up.

steps.title: Instruct Participant
steps.instruction: Establish contact with the individual to be swabbed and provide instructions.

steps.title: Perform Nasal Swabbing
steps.instruction: Collect samples from both nostrils using the swab.

substeps.instruction: Pick up the swab from the sleeve, open the sleeve completely, and lay the swab on the opened sleeve.
Insert the swab gently into the nostril until resistance is met.
Gently scrub all sides of the nostril and leave the swab in place for 15 seconds.
Repeat the process in the other nostril.

steps.title: Secure Sample in Tube
steps.instruction: Transfer the collected sample into the transport tube.

substeps.instruction: Remove the swab and lid together.
Slide the swab into the tube and secure the lid.
Holding the lid shut, pull straight on the handle to remove the stick through the opening, leaving the swab pad in the tube.
Insert the plug securely and discard the stick.

steps.title: Package and Decontaminate Samples
steps.instruction: Secure the tubes for transport and sanitize the exterior.

substeps.instruction: Place the tubes in the biohazard bag.
Decontaminate the exterior of the biohazard bag with 70% ethanol.

steps.title: Transport and Store Samples
steps.instruction: Move the samples to the processing site and maintain cold chain.

substeps.instruction: Transport the cooler and swabbing kit to the site for sample processing.
Place the samples in a 4ºC fridge or coldroom.
Wash hands with soap and water.
Remove PPE before returning to the vehicle.
